Customers can earn CommBank yellow points in a range of ways, creating more opportunities to be rewarded than ever before.
One of the biggest changes is that customers can now earn points based on their relationship with the bank, not just their spending.
eligible customers can earn points when taking out eligible products, renewing existing products, and reaching key banking milestones.
This means customers can be recognised for more of the ways they bank with CommBank throughout their customer journey.
Customers who currently earn points through a CommBank Awards credit card will transition to earning CommBank yellow points.
They'll continue to earn points on eligible purchases, with the number of points earned dependent on their ComBank yellow tier, ComBank yellow, plus, gold or diamond.
In addition to earning points through their credit card, they'll also have access to the broader range of earning opportunities available through ComBank Yellow.
Customers can also earn points when shopping with participating partner stores through the ComBank Yellow Hub in the ComBank app.
This introduces a new way for customers to be rewarded on their everyday shopping with participating brands.
The current cashback feature will be replaced by bonus points offers, allowing customers to boost their CommBank yellow points balance by activating eligible offers in the CommBank app.
These offers will be regularly updated and provide even more opportunities to earn points.
For customers with eligible points earning cards, Points earned through activated offers are in addition to the points they earn on eligible card purchases, creating even more ways to be rewarded.
Whether customers are banking, spending, shopping, or reaching important milestones, ComBank Yellowpoints provides more ways to earn rewards across their relationship with the bank.
